validation.featureEvidence: PTC research against the installed core showed nested tool calls run the identical pre/post-execute pipeline and ferry their additionalContexts up through the outer run_code result, while a throwing tools/post-execute listener replaces a nested result (and every context ferried through it) with a bare error. The post-execute observation is now non-fatal for observer failures but still rethrows the exact caller abort reason, and a regression test locks both the abort reason and the observer-failure contract.
